_note: Corpus FICTIF : passages réglementaires en anglais + notes internes en français, avec des passages pièges au vocabulaire proche. Questions en français.

passages.P01: Citral: the maximum concentration in leave-on skin products (Category 4) is reduced from 0.6% to 0.4% in the finished product.
passages.P02: Citral in rinse-off products such as shower gels and shampoos (Category 9) remains authorised at up to 1.2% in the finished product.
passages.P03: Methyl eugenol is prohibited in all leave-on products. In rinse-off products, the maximum authorised level is 0.01%.
passages.P04: Coumarin: no change to the concentration limit. Labelling remains mandatory above 0.001% in leave-on products and above 0.01% in rinse-off products.
passages.P05: New products placed on the market from 15 January 2027 must comply immediately. Products already on the market must comply by 15 September 2027.
passages.P06: Hydroxycitronellal: the restriction for oral care products (toothpaste, mouthwash) is aligned with the limit for lip products.
passages.P07: Candles and home fragrance products (Category 11) are outside the scope of this amendment and are covered by a separate standard.
passages.P08: Benzyl salicylate: a safety review has been opened; no new limit applies before the conclusions expected in 2028.
passages.P09: Les clients de la zone EMEA demandent davantage de parfums « clean label » pour les soins sans rinçage.
passages.P10: L'accord CitruNova offre un profil citronné sans citral ; il est validé en interne comme alternative pour les soins sans rinçage.
passages.P11: Le délai moyen de reformulation annoncé par l'équipe d'application est de 10 semaines, tests de stabilité compris.
passages.P12: Lumea Cosmetics a lancé en 2025 une gamme corps dont le Lait corps Douceur, parfumé avec un accord citronné.
passages.P13: Les ventes de bougies parfumées progressent de 8 % par an en Europe selon la dernière étude de marché.
passages.P14: L'accord Zest-21 contient 0,1 % de citral ; il est réservé aux produits rincés ou aux faibles dosages.
passages.P15: Limonene and linalool are listed among the fragrance allergens that must be declared on the label above the thresholds set by the cosmetics regulation.
passages.P16: Children's toys containing fragrances are subject to the toy safety directive, which lists prohibited fragrance substances.
